task_completion.description: Agent accesses the OAuth2 credentials from the local file system.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of ~/api_credentials.txt.

task_completion.description: Agent successfully requests an authentication token from the OAuth endpoint.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command (e.g., curl or postman-like tool) targeting http://localhost:8080/oauth/token showing a JSON response containing an 'access_token'.

task_completion.description: Agent queries the institution endpoint and receives data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A request to http://localhost:8080/admin-api/v1/institution and the resulting JSON data displayed on screen.

task_completion.description: Agent queries the useraccount and configuration_node endpoints.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Requests to http://localhost:8080/admin-api/v1/useraccount and http://localhost:8080/admin-api/v1/configuration_node with corresponding JSON responses.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the JSON responses to the specified directory and filenames.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or 'ls' command showing institutions.json, users.json, and configurations.json inside the /home/ga/api_export directory.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually type out the JSON content into the files.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent should be seen capturing the output of the API calls rather than typing long strings of synthetic data manually.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the localhost:8080 server rather than mock files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Network tool logs or terminal commands showing active requests to localhost:8080.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific directory requested in the instructions.
integrity.visual_evidence: The path /home/ga/api_export is explicitly used in commands or file explorer views.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The expected output directory is exactly /home/ga/api_export. The required files are institutions.json, users.json, and configurations.json. The data is synthetic SEB Server demo data. The agent must use the credentials found in ~/api_credentials.txt to authenticate via the /oauth/token endpoint before accessing the admin-api endpoints.
